notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for canceling a negotiated regular ownership transfer before confirmation delivery after a timed regional attribute update, federation save, and federation restore. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It covers standard region metadata, timestamped attribute reflection, timed save and restore callbacks, ownership acquisition and negotiated divestiture cancellation, acquisition-cancellation callbacks, Flush Queue delivery, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics. The immediate callback-model case remains an explicit candidate skip because synchronous delivery closes the pre-delivery cancellation window before the first candidate resigns.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional subscription and registration, timestamped attribute update, timed save/restore, ownership acquisition and negotiated divestiture cancellation, time advance, Flush Queue, and standard FederateAmbassador delivery callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador object-management, DDM, time-management, save/restore, and ownership-management declarations
